schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::PortalPublication. Drives the publish/unpublish lifecycle of an AWS::APIPortal::Portal. A separate resource keyed on PortalArn with a customer-controlled ChangeToken as the change-trigger. Customers may set ChangeToken to a literal value, a CFN parameter (manual republish), or a Fn::Sub-composed string referencing dependent resources' UpdatedAt attributes (auto-republish through CFN's dependency graph).

ChangeToken.description: Customer-supplied change-trigger string. Any change forces a republish on UpdateHandler. Customers may set this to a literal token, a CFN parameter, or a Fn::Sub-composed string (for example, a concatenation of dependent resources' UpdatedAt attributes) to chain republish through CFN's dependency graph.

Description.description: A description of the changes made in this published version. Forwarded to PublishPortal.description.

PortalArn.description: The ARN of the parent portal that this PortalPublication targets.
